subject: OS X tip: enabling Quick Look for stan files

messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: OS X tip: enabling Quick Look for stan files
parts:
As an OS X user, I've been mildly irked by the lack of Quick Look support for stan files. Turns out enabling it is as simple as:

brew install Caskroom/cask/qlstephen

(see: http://whomwah.github.io/qlstephen )
